jmv-adjunto-no-escrito: Could not write the attached PDF with the sending account logo (%file%). The email goes out with the PDF that was already generated.
jmv-adjunto-no-regenerado: Could not generate the PDF with the sending account format. The email goes out with the PDF that was already generated.
jmv-duplicada: Account duplicated. The copy is disabled: change its email address and enable it.
jmv-email-no-valido: The email address %email% is not valid.
jmv-email-repetido: There is already another active account with the address %email%. Disable one of them or change its address.
jmv-falta-host: An outgoing mail server is required to send through SMTP.
jmv-formato-ayuda: The PDF attached when sending from this account will be generated with this format, so it goes out with its logo, title and footer text. If empty, the format matching the document is used.
jmv-formato-no-encontrado: Printing format %id% no longer exists. Please check the sending account.
jmv-orden-ayuda: Lower numbers come first in the drop-down.
jmv-predeterminada-ayuda: The default account comes pre-selected when sending. There can only be one.
jmv-recordar: Remember the format each document was sent with
jmv-recordar-ayuda: When enabled, the document is marked with the format it was sent with, and any copy printed or resent later goes out with the same logo the customer received. If you pick a format by hand when printing, the one you pick wins.
jmv-remitente-ayuda: The name the customer sees in the email. If empty, the account name is used.
jmv-replyto-ayuda: Address customers reply to, if different from the sending address.
jmv-replyto-no-valido: The reply address %email% is not valid.
jmv-sin-clave: Could not encrypt the sending account passwords: the encryption key could not be saved to config.php nor to the MyFiles folder. Please check write permissions.
jmv-sin-openssl: Could not encrypt the sending account passwords because the server does not have the PHP openssl extension.
jmv-usuario-ayuda: The server login user, only if different from the email address.
